chapter_01.description: First New Game choice. Native HERZ part 1: tutorial, level 50.

chapter_02.description: Second New Game choice. Native HERZ part 2: first story campaign.

chapter_03.description: Third New Game choice. Native HERZ part 3: second story campaign. Grant is a character name.

save_unreadable.description: Save/load slot label when its file cannot be decoded. User-entered save names are not translated.

save_empty.description: Load screen feedback after selecting an unused save slot.

save_name_required.description: Save screen feedback after confirming an empty name.

inventory_health.description: Inventory label above the life meter; compact right-hand column.

hud_gold.description: Gameplay HUD while holding gold near the shop. Keep the {amount} placeholder; its position may change.

percent.description: Inventory health, medicine and electricity percentages. Keep {amount}; change spacing/percent position as needed.

door_locked.description: Centered prompt when trying a locked door without unlocking it.

door_wrong_key.description: Centered prompt when the held key does not match the door.

shop_insufficient_gold.description: Centered prompt after trying to buy an item costing more gold than the player has.

tutorial_00.message: Enter the room right in front of you.
tutorial_00.description: Training entrance. TUR39 row 0, selected by object.itemValue (zero-based). Do not renumber tutorial IDs.

tutorial_01.message:
Stand right in front of the door.
Press <highlight>Return</highlight>.
tutorial_01.description: Training: first door. TUR39 row 1. Newline splits the centered prompt; highlight marks the key name.

tutorial_03.message:
The key now is in your inventory.
You can now open the door.
tutorial_03.description: Training: after picking up the key. TUR39 row 3.

tutorial_04.message:
Pull the lever on the wall
to briefly open the door.
tutorial_04.description: Training: timed lever-operated door. TUR39 row 4.

tutorial_05.message:
In this room there is a secret
passage hidden behind the wall.
tutorial_05.description: Training: secret passage room. TUR39 row 5.

tutorial_07.message:
Move through the fire quickly to
take least possible damage.

tutorial_08.message:
Now take the healing potion
to restore your health.
tutorial_08.description: Training: healing potion pickup after the fire. TUR39 row 8.

tutorial_09.message:
Press F2 to bring up the inventory
and drag the healing potion onto
the <highlight>knife and fork</highlight> icon.
tutorial_09.description: Training: using medicine in the inventory. TUR39 row 9. Preserve F2 and highlight tags. Three centered lines.

tutorial_10.message:
Pick up all weapons in this room.
You will need them...

tutorial_11.message:
Climb the ladder using
the JUMP hotkey.
tutorial_11.description: Training: ladder. TUR39 row 11. JUMP refers to the configured jump action.

tutorial_13.message:
Pull the lever under water
and dive to the exit.
tutorial_13.description: Training: underwater exit lever. TUR39 row 13.

ending_00.description: Final level 26: Grant recognizes Kjarthan. TUR38 row 0. Character name/exclamation, NOT tutorial row 0; separate prefix prevents a collision.

item_131.description: Shop description 131. Keep {price}; supplied from the object's authored cost.

item_138.message: The rat trap costs {price} gold coins

item_139.message: The conductor ball costs {price} gold coins

item_141.message: The arrow poison costs {price} gold coins

item_142.description: Inventory cursor-over item name 142 (BEZEICH.TXT, one-based); not a shop description.

tutorial_00.description: Training entrance. TUR39 row 0, selected by object.itemValue (zero-based). Do not renumber tutorial IDs.

tutorial_01.message:
Stelle Dich unmittelbar vor die Tür.
Drücke <highlight>Enter</highlight>
tutorial_01.description: Training: first door. TUR39 row 1. Newline splits the centered prompt; highlight marks the key name.

tutorial_03.message:
Der Schlüssel liegt nun im Inventar.
Die Tür lässt sich nun öffnen
tutorial_03.description: Training: after picking up the key. TUR39 row 3.

tutorial_04.message:
Ziehe den Hebel an der Wand
damit sich die Tür öffnet
tutorial_04.description: Training: timed lever-operated door. TUR39 row 4.

tutorial_05.message:
In diesem Raum ist ein Geheimgang
hinter einer Wand
tutorial_05.description: Training: secret passage room. TUR39 row 5.

tutorial_07.message:
Bewege Dich schnell durchs Feuer
um wenig Schaden zu nehmen

tutorial_08.message:
Nimm nun die Medizinflasche
um die Lebensenergie wieder aufzufrischen
tutorial_08.description: Training: healing potion pickup after the fire. TUR39 row 8.

tutorial_09.message:
Wechsle mit F2 ins Inventar-Fenster
und bewege die Medizinflasche auf
das Symbol <highlight>Messer und Gabel</highlight>
tutorial_09.description: Training: using medicine in the inventory. TUR39 row 9. Preserve F2 and highlight tags. Three centered lines.

tutorial_10.message:
Nimm alle Waffen aus diesem Raum.
Du wirst sie brauchen...

tutorial_11.message:
Klettere die Leiter mit
der Sprungtaste hoch.
tutorial_11.description: Training: ladder. TUR39 row 11. Sprungtaste refers to the configured jump action.

tutorial_13.message:
Ziehe unter Wasser den Hebel
und tauche zum Ausgang.
tutorial_13.description: Training: underwater exit lever. TUR39 row 13.

ending_00.description: Final level 26: Grant recognizes Kjarthan. TUR38 row 0. Character name/exclamation, NOT tutorial row 0; separate prefix prevents a collision.
